meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 Emacs 适配器和 Lisp 客户端复制进你的 NanoClaw 项目，写入 .env 并完成频道注册。之后你可以在 Emacs 聊天缓冲区里对话，或把 org 子树、选区发出去，回复以内嵌子标题返回。
howto.when: 当你想把 Emacs 接入 NanoClaw 作为对话频道时触发。技能会先检查项目里是否已有适配器与 Lisp 文件，缺失则执行安装流程。

say.text: 帮我把 Emacs 接成 NanoClaw 的频道
say.note: 会拷贝适配器、Lisp 客户端并写入 .env

say.text: 我用 Doom Emacs，给我对应的配置和按键绑定
say.note: 给出 config.el 里的 map! 配置与按键

say.text: 验证一下 Emacs 频道是不是已经跑起来
say.note: 检查 HTTP 端点返回与启动日志

howto.what_en: After install, Claude copies the Emacs adapter and Lisp client into your NanoClaw project, writes the .env config, and loads nanoclaw.el in Emacs. Then chat in an Emacs buffer or send an org subtree; replies appear as child headings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want Emacs wired up as a NanoClaw channel. The skill checks whether the adapter and Lisp files already exist, and if not, runs the install steps.

say_en.text: Add Emacs as a NanoClaw channel
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, Lisp client, and .env config

say_en.text: I use Doom Emacs — give me the config and keybindings
Check whether the Emacs channel is running
say_en.note: Verifies the HTTP endpoint and startup log line
